Raj V: Planning tenant_metadata migration + backfill tonight 23:00 UTC. ~120M rows. Using 8 shards, sequential waves, throttle to ~30r/s. Need deploybot holdpoints + rollback plan.
Anna M: Ack. Will we gate after a canary?

Kyle H: Abort flow?

DeployBot: scheduled run: migration-job-runner start=2024-08-02T23:00:00Z shards=8 concurrency=2 rate=30r/s. holdpoint after shard=2.
SRE-Lead: Add auto-pause triggers to runbook: replica_lag >5s for 60s, lock_waits >40/min, db_cpu >85%. If triggered, DeployBot auto-pauses and @channel. Manual resume required.
Anna M: Canary start cmd:
```
deploybot run --plan tenant-meta --shards 0..1 --rate 30 --concurrency 2
```
Pause: `deploybot pause --plan tenant-meta`
Priya S: Dry-run in staging at 20:30 UTC with same throttles. I'll post logs here.
